budgets._comment: Re-baselined when the shell replaced its overflow menu with one named nav. Every destination is now in the prerendered HTML, which is what makes them crawlable and reachable without JavaScript, so ~15 labelled rows and their icons ship in the shell instead of 6. Raised again when theme and accent joined the navigation: the sidebar's copy of the pair ships in the shell, which is ~2 KiB of icon markup raw and nothing measurable brotli. The Menu sheet's copy waits for the sheet, so it costs the shell nothing. Header settings and project links add about 1.7 KiB of raw shell markup. The complete home-page bundle flow adds about 1.4 KiB of raw semantic markup while reducing the Brotli size below this budget's compressed target. The Extract workflow adds one labelled Files row to the shell. The guided cheat tours add about 0.2 KiB of raw home-shell markup; the approved raw limit is 56,000 bytes.
budgets.name: HTML shell

budgets._comment: Raised for the Extract workflow route and its browser archive selection UI. Raised again for the browser feature map and the Identify, Extract, Convert, Trim, PPF Undo, and Settings guides, whose rendered pages ship as docs route chunks. Raised again for the ISO to RVZ, Nintendo 3DS to Z3DS, and Extract Z3DS guides, whose route chunks add about 11 KiB raw and 3 KiB Brotli. Raised again for the Pro Action Rocky, Gold Finger, and GBA GameShark/Action Replay code types and the create form's code type picker. Raised for the WebMCP tools and eleven browser workflow adapters. Raised for the published native benchmarks and expanded format guides. The CI bundle measures 2,496,524 raw bytes and 639,096 Brotli bytes; the approved limits retain 70,000 raw and 9,000 Brotli bytes above the baseline. Raised again for guided Apply's add-files step and the Guided practice runs reference page: main measured 632.7 KiB Brotli, 1.1 KiB under the old 649,000-byte limit, and the change adds 3.2 KiB (the new page's route chunk is 1.5 KiB of it, the rest is the guide, its de/es copy, and the linking doc edits), bringing the bundle to 635.9 KiB. The Brotli limit rises by 5,000 bytes to keep about 2.8 KiB of headroom; the raw limit is unchanged. The CLI ROM testing and native emulator runtime guides raise the measured bundle to 2,587,352 raw and 660,516 Brotli bytes; the limits retain 70,000 raw and 14,000 Brotli bytes of headroom.
